name: vwap_mean_reversion_v3
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, z-score deviations beyond ±2.7 from session VWAP occur roughly once per session and represent capitulation events — retail margin calls and stop-loss cascades push the index 80-120 spot points below VWAP, accompanied by a visible volume surge as forced sellers hit the bid. At this extreme three distinct buyer types converge simultaneously: VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms crossing their urgency threshold, options dealers short puts who must buy delta as gamma accelerates, and stat-arb desks exploiting index mispricing vs. component futures. The snap-back is sharp (20-40 spot points in 30-90 seconds) because supply thin out immediately after the panic flush. The volume surge confirmation distinguishes genuine capitulation from slow directional drift that can continue.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative_sum(typical_price * volume) / cumulative_sum(volume), reset at session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP is cumulative — no scaling needed. Acts as the institutional benchmark that algorithmic buyers defend.

indicators.name: vwap_stddev_360
indicators.purpose: 30-minute rolling stddev of close prices used to normalize VWAP deviation into a z-score. 360 bars (30 min) chosen because it captures the current intraday volatility regime. The original's 50-bar 1-min (50 min) was context-setting; 30 min at 5s gives similar context while being more responsive to regime shifts within the session.

indicators.name: rel_volume_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute relative volume (24 bars) to detect panic-driven volume surges. The original used 10-bar 1-min (10 min average), but at 5s bars a 10-min average baseline misses intra-session surges. 2-min (24 bars) captures the specific micro-panic burst right around the capitulation candles — which is the distinguishing signal between genuine panic and slow drift to VWAP extreme.

conditions: at least 360 bars of warmup available (30 min from open)
buy_ce.confirmation: Volume surge confirms panic selling rather than orderly directional move

conditions: at least 360 bars of warmup available
buy_pe.confirmation: Volume surge confirms panic buying (short squeeze or stop-hunt overshoot)

exit.stop_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 spot pts at delta 0.5) because at z-score -2.7 the expected snap-back is 20-40 spot pts; a continued decline of 14+ spot pts post-entry signals this is a trending/structural move not a capitulation overshoot, invalidating the thesis. Wider than v18 (stop=6) to accommodate the rarer, more volatile extreme events targeted here.
exit.target_rationale: 12 option pts (~24 spot pts) captures roughly 25-30% of the expected 80-120 spot pt deviation reversion in the first 30-90 seconds. Conservative capture ratio (vs. full reversion to VWAP) because mean reversion on NIFTY rarely completes in a single burst — we take the fast first leg. Gives 1:1.7 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: none — extreme VWAP deviations occur in both high and low VIX regimes; applying VIX filter would reduce an already-rare signal
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST only; first 15 minutes excluded to allow VWAP and stddev to stabilize
filters.volume_filter: rel_volume_24 > 1.7 is the core volume confirmation — distinguishes panic from drift
filters.trend_filter: none — this strategy FADES the extreme move, trend alignment would contradict the thesis
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — behavioral panic patterns are persistent but SEBI circuit breakers and algo risk controls may reduce extreme deviations over time

adaptation_notes: Differentiated from vwap_mean_reversion_v18 (deep reversion, z<-1.7, dev_momentum trigger, stop=6/target=10) and vwap_mean_reversion_v19 (moderate 20-35pt deviations, microstructure basing with bar_range + close_vs_low, stop=4/target=6). This v3 targets the rarest, most extreme deviations (z<-2.7) with a VOLUME SURGE confirmation that is absent from both prior versions. The mechanism is multi-buyer convergence rather than single-institution accumulation (v18) or gamma-hedger fade (v19). Wider stop (7 vs 6) and larger target (12 vs 10) reflect the more explosive but less frequent nature of 2.7-sigma events. lookback_std compressed from 50 1-min bars (50 min) to 360 5s bars (30 min) for session responsiveness. rel_volume lookback compressed from 10 1-min bars (10 min) to 24 5s bars (2 min) to detect the acute burst rather than a 10-minute baseline.
weaknesses: Signal fires very rarely (1-4x/day at z>2.7 threshold) — low trade count limits statistical significance in short backtests
Flash crashes may gap through stop before execution
VWAP stddev can be artificially low in the first 30 minutes, inflating z-scores — session start filter mitigates this
On expiry days, extreme deviations may not revert if caused by options settlement hedging flows
